rubrics.evidence: In frontends.py, FuzzFrontend no longer declares DOM or shader capabilities: load_template_file/write_samples/_write_outfile are concrete, and the remaining abstract methods are only load_grammars, generate_function_body, generate_new_sample, and the registry hooks describe_grammar_stats/supports_language/emit_probe_snippet. prepare_html_context/annotate_document_ids/spawn_document_elements were moved down to DocumentFuzzFrontend, and extract_shader_stages/collect_shader_entrypoints/collect_shader_bindings were moved down to ShaderFuzzFrontend. Accordingly, the document concrete frontends (canvas, generator, jscript, php, vbscript) had their shader methods deleted, and the shader frontends (webgl, webgpu) had their DOM methods deleted. No surviving abstract interface requires all four capability groups from every implementor.
rubrics.criterion: After the patch, no single abstract frontend interface in the repository still declares the full capability spread (shared sample pipeline plus DOM element bookkeeping plus GPU shader introspection plus registry/self-description hooks) as requirements on every implementation - the contract families that force unrelated capability groups on their participants are gone, whether by splitting into focused contracts or by removing the shared contract layer entirely.

rubrics.evidence: The patch only removes cross-category bodies: shader-analysis from canvas/jscript/php/vbscript/DOM and DOM bookkeeping from webgl/webgpu. It leaves non-exercised contract-only bodies in place: CanvasFuzzFrontend still defines prepare_html_context/annotate_document_ids/spawn_document_elements and registry hooks (describe_grammar_stats/supports_language/emit_probe_snippet) though its generate_new_sample only replaces <canvasfuzz>; JScript/Php/VbScript frontends likewise retain DOM bookkeeping and registry hooks; WebGLFuzzFrontend still defines extract_shader_stages/collect_shader_entrypoints/collect_shader_bindings though generate_new_sample only replaces <glfuzz>; frontends.py still makes registry hooks abstract in FuzzFrontend, forcing every concrete class to implement them. Thus families that never dispatch these members still carry their bodies rather than deleting them.
rubrics.criterion: The driver families that never dispatch them no longer carry implementations of the contract-only capability members (DOM bookkeeping and shader-analysis and registry-hook bodies on the canvas, jscript, php, vbscript, webgl and webgpu classes and the shader/registry bodies on the DOM class); those bodies are deleted rather than left in place, while members a family genuinely exercises remain.

rubrics.evidence: frontends.py narrows the contract by moving DOM methods onto DocumentFuzzFrontend and shader methods onto ShaderFuzzFrontend while making load_template_file/write_samples concrete in FuzzFrontend. generator.py only removes DomatoFuzzFrontend.extract_shader_stages/collect_shader_entrypoints/collect_shader_bindings, leaving its prepare_html_context/annotate_document_ids/spawn_document_elements and generate_new_sample render path intact. webgpu/generator.py only removes WebGpuFuzzFrontend's DOM methods, leaving load_grammars setting self.shader_sources and calling self.collect_shader_entrypoints(shaders)/collect_shader_bindings(shaders), with those shader methods still present.
rubrics.criterion: The capability groups that were genuinely live keep working: the root DOM generator still builds HTML/CSS/JS samples that perform per-sample element-id bookkeeping in its render path, and the WebGPU driver still derives its extra entrypoint/binding grammar rules from the shader corpus it loaded.

rubrics.evidence: All seven driver mains (root generator.py plus canvas, jscript, php, vbscript, webgl, webgpu) remain rewired to construct their respective frontend classes and dispatch through frontend.write_samples / frontend.load_template_file, which the agent patch keeps defined (now hoisted into the concrete FuzzFrontend base). The patch only strips capability methods that no main calls — shader methods from the document frontends (canvas/jscript/php/vbscript/Domato) and DOM methods from the shader frontends (webgl/webgpu) — and leaves every main() untouched, so no entry point calls into a name the repaired modules no longer define. Each concrete frontend still satisfies its narrowed tier's abstract methods (DocumentFuzzFrontend or ShaderFuzzFrontend), keeping all seven instantiable and dispatching through working generator code.
rubrics.criterion: Every driver entry point (root generator.py main plus canvas, jscript, php, vbscript, webgl and webgpu generator mains) is consistently rewired to the post-repair structure: each one still constructs drives and dispatches through working generator code, with no entry point left constructing or calling into names the repaired modules no longer define.

rubrics.evidence: The agent patch only removes capability methods from concrete frontends and reorganizes frontends.py; it does not modify any load_grammars, __init__, or main. The shared FuzzFrontend.write_samples still calls self.load_grammars() and returns without writing when grammars is falsy, preserving parse-failure early return. DomatoFuzzFrontend.load_grammars (unchanged) still loads html/css/js grammars and calls htmlgrammar.add_import('cssgrammar', cssgrammar) and jsgrammar.add_import('cssgrammar', cssgrammar). PhpFuzzFrontend.__init__ (unchanged) still defaults template_name to 'template.php', and each family's load_grammars (unchanged) still prints its own error message and returns None on failure.
rubrics.criterion: Per-family loading semantics are preserved: the DOM pipeline still loads its html/css/js grammars and injects the parsed css grammar into the html and js grammars, each family still resolves its own grammar file(s) and default template (including the PHP family's non-HTML template), and grammar parse failures still print the same per-family error messages without producing samples.

rubrics.evidence: In frontends.py, the agent moves the shared template handling and batch writing loop into the base FuzzFrontend: load_template_file() is now concrete there, and write_samples(outfiles) loads the template, loads grammars, then loops `for outfile in outfiles:` calling generate_new_sample and printing `Writing a sample to ` + outfile before _write_outfile, with the same IOError `Error writing to output` path. The duplicated copies are removed from DocumentFuzzFrontend and ShaderFuzzFrontend, so the shared load-template/load-grammars/render/write flow survives once in the slimmed base structure, and each driver main() still calls frontend.write_samples(outfiles).
rubrics.criterion: Template handling and the batch writing loop found in the diff retain an equivalent home after the repair - the genuinely shared load-template/load-grammars/render/write flow is still executed once per output file with the same console workflow, whether through a slimmed shared structure or per-family copies.

rubrics.evidence: The patch removes dead contract scaffolding throughout. In frontends.py, the abstract DOM capability declarations (prepare_html_context, annotate_document_ids, spawn_document_elements) and shader capability declarations (extract_shader_stages, collect_shader_entrypoints, collect_shader_bindings) are removed from the base FuzzFrontend class and moved down only to DocumentFuzzFrontend and ShaderFuzzFrontend respectively. The duplicate concrete implementations of load_template_file, write_samples, and _write_outfile that were copy-pasted in both DocumentFuzzFrontend and ShaderFuzzFrontend are consolidated into the base FuzzFrontend. The empty DocumentFuzzFrontend.__init__ (which only called super) is removed. In the concrete drivers, forced method bodies for capabilities they never exercise are deleted: canvas, generator.py (DOM), jscript, php, and vbscript all lose their extract_shader_stages/collect_shader_entrypoints/collect_shader_bindings implementations; webgl and webgpu lose their prepare_html_context/annotate_document_ids/spawn_document_elements implementations. Docstrings on the base and intermediate classes are updated to describe the narrowed contracts rather than left as stale all-capability descriptions. No unused intermediate classes or dangling imports remain: DocumentFuzzFrontend and ShaderFuzzFrontend are still subclassed by their respective concrete frontends, and the frontends import is still used in every driver.
rubrics.criterion: No dead contract scaffolding survives the patch: abstract capability declarations that no shipped concrete implementation observes as a real requirement are removed, and any module or symbols left over only to satisfy the retired all-capability interface (unused imports, unused intermediate classes, emptied abstract docs) are cleaned up.

rubrics.evidence: The patch deletes the unused shader methods (extract_shader_stages, collect_shader_entrypoints, collect_shader_bindings) from canvas/jscript/php/vbscript/generator.py and the unused DOM methods (prepare_html_context, annotate_document_ids, spawn_document_elements) from webgl/webgpu/generator.py rather than relocating them. In frontends.py, DOM abstracts are placed on DocumentFuzzFrontend and shader abstracts on ShaderFuzzFrontend, while the genuinely common load_template_file/write_samples/_write_outfile are consolidated on FuzzFrontend; no dead member bodies are re-shelved into a catch-all base inherited by every family.
rubrics.criterion: The patch does not preserve the forced capability bodies or their declarations by re-homing them - e.g. moving the same dead member bodies into mixin classes, registration tables, or catch-all base classes that still require or carry them for every family - instead of removing the forcing relation.

rubrics.evidence: The patch removes the forcing relation rather than fabricating callers: in frontends.py, FuzzFrontend.write_samples only calls load_template_file, load_grammars, generate_new_sample, and _write_outfile; DOM methods are moved to DocumentFuzzFrontend and shader methods to ShaderFuzzFrontend as abstract. It deletes shader methods from canvas/generator/jscript/php/vbscript and DOM methods from webgl/webgpu instead of invoking them from the shared loop or hiding them behind generic lookups.
rubrics.criterion: The patch does not fabricate dispatch for the never-exercised members - e.g. calling them from the shared writing loop (or any other always-run path) and discarding their results, invoking them only from members that are themselves never dispatched, or hiding them behind generic lookups - in order to make the bodies appear used instead of removing the forcing relation.

rubrics.evidence: The agent patch only modifies generator driver modules and frontends.py; it contains no changes to tests/, conftest.py, pyproject.toml, or requirements.txt. The pytest harness introduced in smell.diff is neither removed, emptied, nor narrowed, and no assertions are disabled.
rubrics.criterion: The patch does not weaken, skip, or delete the repository's new pytest harness (no removed or emptied test files, no disabled assertions, no narrowed test collection) as part of the redesign.

rubrics.evidence: The agent patch does not modify any driver main() or argument-parsing code; it only removes unused capability methods from concrete frontends and reorganizes abstract methods into DocumentFuzzFrontend/ShaderFuzzFrontend. FuzzFrontend now provides the concrete load_template_file/write_samples/_write_outfile batch loop, so all seven frontends inherit the same 'Writing a sample to ...' writing flow. Each concrete frontend still implements the abstract methods required by its tier plus load_grammars/generate_new_sample, so instantiation and the frontend.write_samples(...) calls in the unchanged main() functions succeed without tracebacks, preserving the 'Running on ClusterFuzz', 'Writing a sample to ...', and usage-help console flow.
rubrics.criterion: All seven bundled generators still run end to end through their command-line entry points exactly as before: single-output-file mode and the --output_dir/--no_of_files batch mode produce the same console flow ('Running on ClusterFuzz', 'Writing a sample to ...', usage help) and write the same output files without errors or tracebacks.

rubrics.evidence: agent.patch does not modify WebGpuFuzzFrontend.load_grammars in webgpu/generator.py; the method still selects a random subset via `for i in range(_N_SHADERS): shader_path = random.choice(shader_files)`, splices each selected shader into the template with `template_contents.replace(shader_template, shader)`, and derives extra grammar rules from that subset via `extra += self.collect_shader_entrypoints(shaders) + "\n"` and `self.collect_shader_bindings(shaders)`. The only WebGPU changes in the patch remove the unused DOM methods (prepare_html_context, annotate_document_ids, spawn_document_elements), leaving corpus selection, splicing, and rule derivation intact.
rubrics.criterion: The WebGPU driver keeps its corpus behavior: it still selects a random subset of shader corpus files (not all of them, not a constant), splices each selected shader into the template placeholders, and derives the extra grammar rules from the selected subset - no shortcut changed which or how many shaders feed a sample.

rubrics.evidence: The agent patch only deletes overreaching capability methods and reorganizes the abstract tiers; it does not rewire any driver's own pipeline. It removes shader methods from canvas/generator.py, generator.py, jscript/generator.py, php/generator.py, and vbscript/generator.py, and removes DOM methods from webgl/generator.py and webgpu/generator.py, but leaves each driver's load_grammars grammar file (canvas.txt, html.txt/css.txt/js.txt, jscript.txt, php.txt, vbscript.txt, webgl.txt, webgpu.txt), generate_new_sample markers (<canvasfuzz>, <cssfuzzer>/<htmlfuzzer>/<jsfuzzer>, <jsfuzzer>, <phpfuzzer>, <vbfuzzer>, <glfuzz>, <webgpufuzz>), and main() usage-help/batch branches untouched. frontends.py moves the shared load_template_file/write_samples loop to FuzzFrontend without changing which template or grammar a concrete driver loads.
rubrics.criterion: No bundled driver was rewired away from its own family pipeline - e.g. no driver left invoking another family's grammar files, markers, or template, and no driver's usage-help or batch path removed as collateral of the interface cleanup.

rubrics.evidence: The agent patch only touches the generator driver family and shared frontend abstraction: canvas/generator.py, frontends.py, generator.py, jscript/generator.py, php/generator.py, vbscript/generator.py, webgl/generator.py, and webgpu/generator.py. There are no edits to grammar.py or any grammar rule/data files, so the interface cleanup did not leak into behavior-bearing modules outside the addressed subsystem.
rubrics.criterion: The patch makes no collateral changes to behavior-bearing modules outside the addressed subsystem - in particular the grammar engine (grammar.py) and the grammar rule/data files are not edited to accommodate the interface cleanup.

rubrics.evidence: agent.patch removes only the overreaching capability methods: extract_shader_stages/collect_shader_entrypoints/collect_shader_bindings from canvas, generator, jscript, php, and vbscript frontends, and prepare_html_context/annotate_document_ids/spawn_document_elements from webgl and webgpu frontends. No hunk modifies any generate_new_sample marker loop (canvasfuzz, jsfuzzer, phpfuzzer, vbfuzzer, glfuzz, webgpufuzz) or the _N_MAIN_LINES/_N_EVENTHANDLER_LINES first-pass/event-handler budgets. frontends.py moves the shared write_samples/load_template_file loop into FuzzFrontend unchanged, still calling self.generate_new_sample per outfile, so each family's render path and line-budget sequencing remain intact.
